title: Multiple languages (i18n)
description: Chowderr asked 2026-11-10 to add multiple languages. Typed message catalog where every locale must supply every key (compile-time), lint rule banning raw user-facing strings in src/game, test that every locale has every key with matching placeholders, no text in src/sim, lazy-loaded locale chunks to keep the 124 KB budget, navigator.language detection plus a picker. Start with en, es, pt, fr, de, ja, ko, zh-Hans. tibo.dog shipped 10 languages, now 17.

title: Model the run loop as a statechart and model-check it in CI
description:
Chowderr wants Agent Arena to copy poteto's verification approach for tibo.dog story mode, which found several bugs that way (research is in the concept doc's Research notes: https://claude.ai/artifact/SgBYxU6mQP7BfwZNpDWNxp).
- Model the run loop as a statechart: draft, fight, boss phases (3), death, world clear, run end. Use pstack /statechart (v0.15.36, Mermaid output).
- Check it with a formal model (TLA+ or a small model checker in TS), using pstack /create-formal-verification-skill.
- Invariants: a run always ends in exactly one terminal state; a boss phase can't be skipped; the draft offers at most 6 actives and 6 passives; evolutions need both parts at max level.
- CI runs the checks next to the same-seed sim test.
close_reason: Run-loop statechart (RUN_LOOP) drives sim status; BFS model check plus bot-run trace tests in CI; found and fixed win-overwritten-by-death bug

title: Agent tiers 1-5: model the LLM to harnessed-agent part slots in the sim
description: Tiers and slots are listed in the concept doc section Agent growth: from LLM to harness. Each tier unlocks slots. Keep the sim deterministic and integer-only.
close_reason: Tiers 1-5, slot capacities, part catalog, buildAgent and hallucination in the battle engine

title: Decide art direction: plain pixel art or anime style shared with Waifu N Weebs
close_reason: Decided by Chowderr 2026-11-10: follow the tibo.dog research, plain code-defined pixel art. Not Waifu N Weebs.

title: Retire the turn-based autobattler sim
description: src/sim/battle.ts, draft.ts, loadout.ts, run.ts and scripts/balance.ts are no longer used by the game after the real-time rebuild. Port anything still useful into src/sim/arena and delete the rest.

title: First-time tip cards for new objects
description: tibo.dog shows a one-time tip card the first time you meet each new thing (new enemy kind, boss, evolution). Add them to the arena HUD, with a setting to turn them off.

title: Set arena balance targets and test them in CI
description: The kiting bot (npm run arena-balance) now gives bimodal results: some runs stall at boss 1, others win. Pick target bands (survival, bosses per run) and assert them in a test like BALANCE_TARGETS.

title: Ban allocation in per-frame code with a .hot.ts lint rule
description: Follow poteto's rule: files that run every tick or frame end in .hot.ts and lint bans object literals, closures and new in them. Start with src/sim/arena/sim.ts step functions and src/render/world.ts sync.

title: Record inputs so a run link replays the whole run
description: Results set ?seed= in the URL, but a run depends on inputs too. Record per-tick inputs compactly and encode them in the run link so the server or a viewer can replay it, like tibo.dog does.

title: Restyle the Strudel score as lo-fi jazz
description: Chowderr's direction (2026-11-10): lo-fi jazz. That means swung drums, jazzy 7th and 9th chords, mellow keys (Rhodes-like), and a relaxed 70 to 90 bpm. Rework SCORE_LAYERS in src/audio/score.ts so it still layers up by tier. Keep the score tests green.

title: Apply concept-doc parts audit to the parts catalog
description:
The concept doc's 'Weapons, passives and evolutions (audited)' section (under Mastra worlds, https://claude.ai/artifact/SgBYxU6mQP7BfwZNpDWNxp) changes src/sim/parts.ts:
- Model, temperature, context window and system prompt become a pre-run loadout, not draft picks.
- Cut Calculator.
- MCP connector becomes a passive; Subagents becomes a weapon.
- RAG = Web search + Vector memory (replaces Conversation buffer).
- CI Pipeline = Shell + Auto-test hook. Code exec + Sandbox = Code interpreter.
- Target: 10 weapons, 14 passives, one evolution per weapon, plus active+active combos.
Keep BALANCE_TARGETS green after the change.

title: Live Strudel music as a lazy-loaded strudel chunk with a layer per agent tier
description: @strudel/web is AGPL-3.0-or-later; the repo is AGPL so this is fine. Chunk file name must start with strudel so the size check skips it.
close_reason: Strudel score with one layer per tier, lazy strudel chunk, music button

title: Headless balance bot with target win rates per stage
description: Bots play thousands of seeded fights per balance change and report win rates against targets.
close_reason: Greedy and random bots play seeded runs; per-stage clear targets tested in CI; npm run balance prints the report

title: Draft cards between fights: pick 1 of 3, reroll, skip, banish, evolutions
close_reason: Deterministic draft: offer 3, pick, reroll, skip, banish, two evolutions (RAG, CI Pipeline)

title: Gate evolutions: tool at max level plus paired skill, unlocked by beating a stage boss
description: Draft evolutions in src/sim/draft.ts currently fire as soon as both ingredients are owned. The concept doc wants part levels and a boss unlock first.

title: Code-defined pixel sprites from one shared palette, packed at build time
close_reason: Sprites are 16x16 string grids over one 16-color palette, drawn at runtime; the agent gains a layer per tier

title: Mastra link: Build your own agent with Mastra badge and post-run snippet
Name the game and the parody SaaS rivals (fill in over time)
description: Story premise from Chowderr, 2026-11-10: the player builds and owns their own agent, and every rival wants you to rent their agent, one you don't own. Names, mascots and plot beats get filled in as ideas come. There's no rush, and placeholders are fine until then.
